title: Dutch authorities rescue 38 people adrift in rubber boat
english: Dutch authorities recently rescued 38 men found drifting in a rubber boat off the coast of Zeeland. While 36 of the individuals were identified as migrants from Afghanistan, two men from Sudan were arrested on suspicion of human smuggling. This incident is highly unusual for the Netherlands, and officials have launched an investigation to determine where the vessel originated and its intended destination.
amharic: የኔዘርላንድ ባለስልጣናት በዜላንድ የባህር ዳርቻ በጎማ ጀልባ ላይ ተሳፍረው ሲንሳፈፉ የተገኙ 38 ሰዎችን ታድገዋል። ከተሳፋሪዎቹ መካከል 36ቱ ከአፍጋኒስታን የመጡ ስደተኞች ሲሆኑ፣ ሁለቱ የሱዳን ዜጎች ደግሞ ሰዎችን በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ በማሸጋገር ወንጀል ተጠርጥረው በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። በኔዘርላንድ እንዲህ አይነት ክስተት እምብዛም የማይታይ በመሆኑ፣ ባለስልጣናት ጀልባዋ ከየት እንደመጣች እና ወዴት እንደምትሄድ ለማወቅ ምርመራ ጀምረዋል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Nezerlaand namoota 38 ta'an kanneen markabii reebera (rubber boat) irra ta'anii galaana irra badee ture naannoo Zeelaanditti oolchaniiru. Namoota kanneen keessaa 36 godaantota Afgaanistaan yoo ta'an, namoonni lama ammoo lammiilee Sudaan ta'uun isaanii fi namoota seeraan alaa butuun shakkamee to'annoo jala oolaniiru. Qabxiiwwan kanneen biyya Nezerlaanditti haalaan waan hin baratamneef, abbootiin taayitaa markabichi eessaa akka ka'ee fi gara eessaa akka imalaa ture qorachuu jalqabaniiru.

title: Trump loses legal battle over Epstein-linked Wall Street Journal case
english: A federal judge has officially dismissed Donald Trump's $10 billion defamation lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal. The court ruled that Trump failed to prove the newspaper acted with 'actual malice' when reporting on his alleged links to Jeffrey Epstein. The judge criticized the legal team for lacking sufficient evidence to support their claims regarding the disputed birthday letter.
amharic: የፌደራል ዳኛ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በዎል ስትሪት ጆርናል ላይ የመሰረቱትን የ10 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የክብር መጓደል ክስ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ትራምፕ ጋዜጣው ከጄፍሪ ኤፕስታይን ጋር ስላላቸው ግንኙነት በዘገበበት ወቅት 'ሆን ብሎ ሀሰተኛ መረጃ አሰራጭቷል' የሚለውን ህጋዊ መስፈርት ማሟላት እንዳልቻሉ ወስኗል። ዳኛው የቀረበው ክስ በቂ ማስረጃ የሌለው እና አሳማኝ እንዳልሆነ በመግለጽ ጉዳዩን ዘግተውታል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa federaalaa himata guddina maqaa balleessuu kan Doolaara biiliyoona 10 Donald Traamp irratti waltajjii oduu 'Wall Street Journal' irratti dhiyeessan guutummaatti kufaa godheera. Manni murtichaa Traamp gabaasni waltajjichaa walitti dhufeenya isaa fi Jefrii Eppistaayiin irratti gabaase 'hammeenya dhugaa' akka qabu mirkaneessuu dhabuu isaa ibseera. Abbaan seerichaa himanni kun ragaa gahaa kan hin qabneefi hiika kan hin qabne ta'uu isaa hubachiiseera.

title: Palestine Action supporters arrested outside US embassy in London
english: A large crowd of protesters gathered at the American Embassy in London to demonstrate against the UK government's decision to ban the group Palestine Action. Police intervened during the rally, leading to the arrest of 139 individuals. Most of those taken into custody were detained on suspicion of showing support for a prohibited organization.
amharic: በለንደን በሚገኘው የአሜሪካ ኤምባሲ ፊት ለፊት የተሰበሰቡ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተቃዋሚዎች የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም መንግሥት 'ፍልስጤም አክሽን' የተባለውን ቡድን ለመከልከል የወሰደውን እርምጃ በመቃወም ተቃውሟቸውን ገልጸዋል። በስፍራው በተፈጠረው ግጭት ፖሊስ 139 ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። አብዛኞቹ የተያዙት በታገደ ድርጅት ላይ ድጋፍ አሳይተዋል በሚል ጥርጣሬ ነው።
oromo: Hiriirtonni hedduun Londonitti argamuun itti gaafatamaa Ambaasii Amerikaa fuulduratti walga'uun, mootummaan UK garee 'Palestine Action' jedhamu irratti dhorkaa gahuu isaa mormaniiru. Polisiin hiriira kana irratti tarkaanfii fudhateen namoota 139 to'annaa jala oolcheera. Namoonni hedduun kan hidhaman, garee dhorkame tokkoof deggarsa argisiisaniiru jedhamanii shakkamuun dha.

title: Legal filing questions Trump’s claims of non-citizen voting in California
english: A recent court filing challenges the Trump administration’s claim that thousands of non-citizens are registered to vote in California. Data experts analyzed the government's list and discovered that a significant portion of the flagged individuals were not actually on voter rolls, while many others were incorrectly labeled despite being eligible US citizens. This evidence contradicts the administration's lawsuit, which seeks to set aside ballots from these voters just days before the midterm elections.
amharic: አዲስ የፍርድ ቤት ሰነድ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በካሊፎርኒያ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ዜጋ ያልሆኑ ሰዎች ድምጽ ለመስጠት ተመዝግበዋል በሚል የሚያቀርበውን ክስ ውድቅ የሚያደርግ መረጃ ይዟል። የመረጃ ባለሙያዎች በመንግስት ዝርዝር ውስጥ የተካተቱት ብዙዎቹ ሰዎች በምርጫ መዝገብ ውስጥ እንደሌሉ፣ ሌሎች በርካታ ሰዎች ደግሞ ህጋዊ የዩኤስ ዜጎች እንደሆኑ አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ማስረጃ የአስተዳደሩን ክስ ጥያቄ ውስጥ የጣለ ሲሆን፣ ለምርጫው ጥቂት ቀናት ብቻ እንደቀሩ ድምፃቸውን የተጠረጠሩትን ሰዎች የምርጫ ካርድ ለማገድ እየተደረገ ያለውን ጥረት አላግባብ ያደርገዋል።
oromo: Galmeen mana muratti dhiyaate tokko, mootummaan Tramp namoonni lammii biyyaa hin taane kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman Kaalifoorniyaa keessatti sagalee kennuuf galmaa'aniiru jechuun himatu fudhatama akka hin qabne saaxileera. Ogeeyyoonni daataa tarree mootummaan dhiyeesse qorachuun, namoonni hedduun akka hin galmoofne fi kanneen biroon immoo lammiilee Ameerikaa seera qabeessa ta'anii osoo jiranii dogoggoraan 'lammii hin taane' jedhamanii adda baafamuu isaanii mirkaneessaniiru. Ragaan kun himannaa mootummaan filannoo gidduu waggaa dura dhiyeesse fi sagalee namoota kanneenii adda baasuuf yaalu sun dhugummaa akka hin qabne argisiisa.

title: Fiery confrontations between protestors and police in Albania
english: Violent clashes erupted in Albania this past Saturday as demonstrators threw petrol bombs and stones at security forces. These protests have been ongoing for several weeks, with students at the forefront calling for the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama. Critics have also raised concerns regarding the police's use of aggressive tactics during these confrontations.
amharic: ባለፈው ቅዳሜ በአልባኒያ በተቀሰቀሰ ተቃውሞ ሰልፈኞች በፖሊስ ላይ የነዳጅ ቦምቦችን እና ድንጋዮችን በመወርወር ግጭት ተፈጥሯል። ለበርካታ ሳምንታት ሲካሄድ በቆየው በዚህ የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ ተማሪዎች ቀዳሚ ሚና እየተጫወቱ ሲሆን፣ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኤዲ ራማን ስልጣን መልቀቅ ጠይቀዋል። በሌላ በኩል ፖሊስ የተቃውሞውን አካሄድ ለመቆጣጠር ከመጠን ያለፈ ሃይል ተጠቅሟል የሚል ትችት እየቀረበበት ነው።
oromo: Guyyaa Sanbataa darbe biyya Albaniyaa keessatti hiriirtonni humnoota nageenyaa irratti hidda boba'aa fi dhagaa darbannaa godhaniiru. Hiriirri kun torbanoota hedduuf kan itti fufe yoo ta'u, barattoonni dursanii kan geggeessaa jiran mootummaan Muummichi Ministiraa Edii Raamaa aangoorraa akka gadi bu'an gaafachaa jiru. Gama biraatiin, poolisiin tarkaanfii akkaan cimaa fudhachuu isaatiin qeeqamaa jira.

title: Israel shells south Lebanon towns, builds roads connecting military outposts
english: Israeli forces recently intensified their military presence in southern Lebanon by conducting heavy artillery strikes and airstrikes across multiple towns. Beyond these attacks, the Israeli military is actively constructing new roads through mountainous regions to link its established outposts in the occupied areas. These escalations are part of a broader conflict that has resulted in significant loss of life and mass displacement throughout the country.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጦር በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የሚገኙ ከተሞች ላይ ከባድ የጦር መሳሪያ እና የአየር ድብደባዎችን በማካሄድ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴውን አጠናክሯል። ከእነዚህ ጥቃቶች በተጨማሪ፣ በወረራ በተያዙ አካባቢዎች ያቋቋሟቸውን የጦር ሰፈሮች ለማገናኘት በደጋማ ቦታዎች ላይ አዳዲስ መንገዶችን በመገንባት ላይ ይገኛሉ። ይህ እየተባባሰ የመጣ ግጭት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ህይወት የቀጠፈ እና በርካታ ዜጎችን ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ አድርጓል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el naannoowwan kibba Libaanositti haleellaa meeshaa gurguddaa fi xiyyaaraan geggeessuun sochiin waraana isaanii daran dabaleera. Haleellaa kana cinaatti, waraanni Israa'el bakka qabate keessatti buufataalee isaa walitti fiduuf karaa haaraa lafa gaaraa irratti ijaaraa jira. Gurguddatni waraana kanaa lubbuu namoota kumaatamaan lakkaawwaman kan galaafate yoo ta'u, namoonni miliyoona tokko ol ta'an immoo qe'ee isaaniirraa buqqa'aniiru.

title: Israeli forces and settlers injure four Palestinians in West Bank attacks
english: On Saturday, Israeli military forces and settlers carried out multiple attacks against Palestinians throughout the West Bank, resulting in at least four injuries. Many of these incidents targeted farmers during the seasonal olive harvest, leading to physical beatings, the theft of crops, and damage to private property. Furthermore, security forces increased movement restrictions by establishing new checkpoints and conducting arrests in several villages.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ዕለት በእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና ሰፋሪዎች በተፈጸሙ ተከታታይ ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ አራት ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቶቹ በዋናነት የወይራ ምርት በሚሰበስቡ አርሶ አደሮች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ሲሆን፣ በአካል ጉዳት ከማድረስ በተጨማሪ የሰብል ዘረፋ እና የንብረት ውድመት ተፈጽሟል። በተጨማሪም የጸጥታ ኃይሎች በአካባቢው አዳዲስ ኬላዎችን በመትከል እና በማሰር እንቅስቃሴዎችን የመገደብ እርምጃ ወስደዋል።
oromo: Guyyaa Sanbataa, waraanni Israa'el fi qonnaan bulaan (settlers) guutuu Baha Baankii (West Bank) keessatti weerara gaggeessaniin namoonni afur madaa'aniiru. Weerara kana keessatti qonnaan bultoota ejjersa (olive) haamaa jiran irratti miidhaan qaamaa ga'eera, akkasumas midhaan isaanii saamamuu fi qabeenyi isaanii manca'eera. Kana malees, humnoonni nageenyaa daandiiwwan irratti sakatta'iinsa haaraa dhaabuudhaan fi namoota to'annoo jala oolchuudhaan sochiin uummata akka daangeffamu taasisaniiru.

title: Syria weighs joining Mecca defence pact, foreign minister says
english: Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani announced that his country is evaluating a potential partnership with the Mecca defence pact. This security agreement, which includes Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan, treats any aggression against one member as an attack on the entire group. This move follows ongoing regional tensions and increased Houthi drone strikes against Saudi infrastructure and holy sites.
amharic: የሶሪያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አስዓድ አል-ሻይባኒ አገራቸው ከመካ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ጋር ለመቀላቀል እያሰበች መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ በሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ በቱርክ እና በፓኪስታን መካከል የተፈረመው ስምምነት፣ በአንድ አባል ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሁሉም ላይ እንደተፈጸመ ይቆጠራል። ውሳኔው የመጣው በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለው የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ጥቃት እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Siiriyaa Asaad al-Shaibani, biyyi isaanii waliigaltee ittisaa kan Makaa waliin makamuuf yaadaa akka jiran ibsaniiru. Waliigalteen kun kan Saudii Arabiyaa, Turkii fi Paakistaan gidduutti mallatteeffame yoo ta'u, miidhaan miseensa tokkorra gahu akka miidhaa hunda irratti gahee ti fudhatama. Murtii kana kan fudhatan erga gareen Huutii weerara drone-ii Saudii Arabiyaa irratti cimsee booda.

title: UN demands probe into death of staff member in Houthi custody
english: The United Nations is calling for a thorough, independent investigation following the death of a staff member who was being held by Houthi forces in Yemen. Mohammad al-Shami had been detained since June 2024, and the UN expressed deep concern over the lack of information regarding the circumstances of his passing. Officials are also demanding the immediate release of dozens of other UN workers who remain in custody.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በየመን በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ቁጥጥር ስር እያለ ህይወቱ ያለፈውን ሰራተኛው ሞት በተመለከተ ገለልተኛ እና አፋጣኝ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ ጠይቋል። መሐመድ አል-ሻሚ ከሰኔ 2016 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ በእስር ላይ የነበሩ ሲሆን፣ ድርጅቱ ስለሞታቸው ሁኔታ ግልጽ መረጃ ባለመሰጠቱ ከፍተኛ ቅሬታ አቅርቧል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በአሁኑ ወቅት በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ታስረው የሚገኙ ሌሎች ሰራተኞቹም በአስቸኳይ እንዲፈቱ አሳስቧል።
oromo: Tokkummaan Mootummootaa (UN) hojjetaa isaa Yemen keessatti harka garee Huutii turetti erga du'ee booda qorannoon walaba ta'e akka gaggeeffamu gaafateera. Mohammad Al-Shaamii ji'a Waxabajjii bara 2024 irraa eegalee hidhamee kan ture yoo ta'u, sababni du'a isaa ifa waan hin taaneef dhaabbatichi gadda guddaa ibseera. UN miseensonni isaa kanneen biroo garee kana harka jiranis battalumatti akka gadhiifaman jabaatee gaafateera.

title: Iran could revisit nuclear weapons ban if war resumes, security chief says
english: A senior Iranian security official indicated that the country might reconsider its prohibition on nuclear weapons if regional conflict escalates, though no formal policy change has occurred. Meanwhile, the U.S. government has initiated diplomatic outreach through Qatari mediators, inviting Iran to direct talks regarding its nuclear program. Iranian leadership views this shift in American tone as positive but insists that U.S. compliance with their demands must precede any potential negotiations.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ የጸጥታ ባለሥልጣን በአካባቢው ግጭት ከተባባሰ አገራቸው የኑክሌር መሳሪያዎችን የመከልከል መመሪያዋን ልትከልስ እንደምትችል ገልጸዋል፣ ምንም እንኳን እስካሁን የተወሰነ ለውጥ ባይኖርም። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ፣ አሜሪካ በኳታር አደራዳሪዎች በኩል ኢራንን ለቀጥታ ንግግሮች በመጋበዝ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ለመጀመር ጥረት እያደረገች ነው። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት የአሜሪካን የቃላት ለውጥ እንደ በጎ ምልክት ቢወስዱትም፣ ማንኛውም ድርድር ከመጀመሩ በፊት አሜሪካ የኢራንን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች ማሟላት እንዳለባት አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni nageenyaa Iraan akka ibsanitti, waraanni naannichaa hammaate yoo ta’e biyyattiin dhorgaa meeshaa niwukilaaraa qabdu kaasuun ishee hin oolu, ta’us hanga ammaatti murteen jijjiiramaa tokkollee hin fudhatamne. Gama biraatiin, Ameerikaan giddu-galeessummaa biyya Qaatar fayyadamuun Iraan marii kallattii niwukilaaraa irratti akka hirmaattu affeerraa taasisteetti. Hoggantoonni Iraan jijjiirama sagalee Ameerikaa kanatti gammadanis, mariin kamiyyuu akka hin jalqabne dura fedhiin Iraan guutamuu akka qabu ibsaniiru.

title: 'We came back from hell', say Ukrainians after years in Russia-occupied front-line city
english: Hundreds of residents have finally escaped the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky after enduring years of extreme hardship and conflict. Trapped by front-line fighting, many survivors faced starvation and life-threatening minefields while living in constant fear. A recent short-term humanitarian ceasefire allowed the families to be evacuated by bus, eventually reuniting them with loved ones in northern Ukraine.
amharic: በሩሲያ ቁጥጥር ስር የነበሩ የኦሌሽኪ ከተማ ነዋሪዎች ከበርካታ አመታት አስከፊ የጦርነት እና የችግር ቆይታ በኋላ በሰላም መውጣት ችለዋል። ነዋሪዎቹ በተከለለ የጦር ግንባር ውስጥ ምግብ በመቸገራቸው እና በማዕድን የተሞሉ አካባቢዎችን በማለፍ ከፍተኛ ስቃይ ደርሶባቸው ነበር። በቅርቡ በተደረገ የሰብአዊ ተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት መሰረት፣ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤተሰቦች በአውቶቡስ ተጭነው ወደ ሰሜናዊ ዩክሬን በመድረስ ከዘመዶቻቸው ጋር ተቀላቅለዋል።
oromo: Namoonni magaala Oleshky keessatti waggoota hedduuf humna Raashiyaan qabamanii turan, rakkoo fi duula cimaa booda nageenyaan bahuu danda'aniiru. Jiraattonni kun naannoo waraanaa keessatti hidhamanii waan turaniif, beelaa fi daandii minii (mine) guutame keessa darbuun lubbuun isaanii waggootaaf balaa keessa ture. Amma garuu, marii tasgabbii namoomaa taasifameen, maatiin dhibbaan lakkaa'aman konkolaataa busiin gara kaaba Yukreen geeffamanii firooma isaanii wajjin wal arguuf carroomaniiru.

title: Clashes erupt between police and protesters in Paris
english: Violent confrontations broke out between police and demonstrators in Paris during a third consecutive weekend of nationwide protests. Over 320,000 people across France marched to demand better public services and relief from the increasing cost of living. Authorities reported at least 290 arrests as officers used tear gas to manage the large crowds.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ ውስጥ በኑሮ ውድነት እና በደካማ የመንግስት አገልግሎቶች ላይ ለሶስተኛ ተከታታይ ሳምንት በተደረገ ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ በፓሪስ ፖሊስ እና በሰልፈኞች መካከል ግጭት ተፈጥሯል። በመላው ሀገሪቱ ከ320,000 በላይ ሰዎች የተሳተፉ ሲሆን ፖሊስ እንባ አዘል ጋዝ በመጠቀም ሰልፈኞችን ለመቆጣጠር ሞክሯል። በዚህ ተቃውሞ ቢያንስ 290 ሰዎች በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል።
oromo: Faransaatti, gatii jireenyaa olka'aa fi tajaajila hawaasummaa hir'ataa mormuudhaan torbee sadaffaaf hiriirri guddaan gaggeeffamee jira. Hiriira kana irratti namoonni kuma 320 ol hirmaataniiru, magaalaa Paaris keessatti immoo poolisiin hiriirtota bittinneessuuf gaazii imimmaansuu fayyadameera. Walitti bu'iinsa uumameen walqabatee namoonni 290 ol ta'an to'annoo jala oolaniiru.

title: Israel’s allegations of Qatari election interference rejected
english: Qatar has officially denied claims that it attempted to influence the results of an Israeli election. The accusations sparked a heated discussion regarding the nature of these allegations. Qatari officials dismissed the claims entirely, labeling them as a coordinated effort to spread misinformation.
amharic: ኳታር በእስራኤል ምርጫ ላይ ጣልቃ ገብታለች የሚለውን ክስ በይፋ አስተባብላለች። እነዚህ ውንጀላዎች በጉዳዩ ዙሪያ ከፍተኛ ክርክር አስነስተዋል። የኳታር ባለስልጣናት ክሱን የሀሰት ፕሮፓጋንዳ ዘመቻ በማለት ውድቅ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Qaatarin filannoo Israa'el irratti dhiibbaa gochuuf yaaltee jettuun himatamee ture guutummaatti haaltetti. Himannaan kun yaada wal-mormii cimaa uumeera. Aangeyyoonni Qaatar himannicha sobaafi ololaan kan guutame ta'uu ibsuun kuffisaniiru.

title: What is ranked-choice voting and how does it work in US elections?
english: Ranked-choice voting is a system used in places like Alaska and Maine that allows voters to rank candidates by preference rather than picking just one. If no candidate wins an initial majority, votes for less popular choices are redistributed to a voter's next preferred candidate. While supporters argue this method reduces the spoiler effect and encourages diverse viewpoints, critics worry it complicates the counting process and may delay final election results.
amharic: የደረጃ ምርጫ (ranked-choice voting) በአላስካ እና ሜይን ያሉ መራጮች ለአንድ እጩ ከመስጠት ይልቅ እንደ ምርጫቸው ቅደም ተከተል እንዲሰጡ የሚያስችል አሰራር ነው። አንድ እጩ አብላጫ ድምፅ ካላገኘ፣ የተሰጠው ድምፅ ለሁለተኛው ተመራጭ ይተላለፋል። የዚህ አሰራር ደጋፊዎች በውድድር ውስጥ የሶስተኛ ወገን እጩዎችን ተፅዕኖ እንደሚቀንስ ሲናገሩ፣ ተቺዎች ግን ድምፅ የመቁጠር ሂደቱን እንደሚያወሳስበው እና ውጤትን እንደሚያዘገይ ስጋታቸውን ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Ranked-choice voting jechuun sirna sagalee kennuu kan akka Alaska fi Mainetti fayyadaman ta'ee, sagalee kennitoonni filannoo tokko qofa osoo hin taane, akkaataa fedhii isaaniitiin hordofuun akka tarreessan godha. Yoo bakka bu'aan tokko sagalee gahaa argachuu baate, sagaleen sun gara filannoo namicha itti aanuutti darba. Goottoota sirnichi filannoo irratti dhiibbaa garaa garaa akka xiqqeessuufi yaada gara garaa akka babal'isu dubbatanis, mormitoonni garuu sirnichaa lakkoofsa sagalee waan wal xaxaa godhuufi bu'aan filannoo akka turu gochuu danda'a jedhanii sodaatu.

title: Turkiye’s Erdogan urges Russia and Ukraine to stop Black Sea attacks
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has called on Russia and Ukraine to cease attacks on civilian vessels in the Black Sea, labeling such actions as unacceptable. During a meeting in Istanbul, Erdogan and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy agreed to collaborate on establishing a new secure corridor for grain shipments. The initiative aims to protect commercial navigation and reduce regional tensions as international pressure for a ceasefire to ensure food and energy supplies continues to grow.
amharic: የቱርክ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ጣይፕ ኤርዶغان ሩሲያ እና ዩክሬን በጥቁር ባህር ውስጥ በሲቪል መርከቦች ላይ የሚያደርሱትን ጥቃት እንዲያቆሙ ጠይቀዋል። በኢስታንቡል ባደረጉት ውይይት ከዩክሬኑ አቻቸው ከቮሎዲሚር ዘሌንስኪ ጋር ለሰብል ትራንስፖርት የሚሆን አዲስ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ኮሪደር ለመፍጠር ተስማምተዋል። ይህ ጥረት የንግድ መርከቦችን እንቅስቃሴ በመጠበቅ በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት ለመቀነስ እና ዓለም አቀፍ የምግብ አቅርቦትን ለማረጋገጥ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Turkii Recep Tayyip Erdogan, biyyoonni Ruusiyaa fi Yukreeniim qilleensa garba gurraacha keessatti dooniiwwan sivilii irratti miidhaa geessisuu akka dhaaban gaafataniiru. Istaambuulitti marii geggeessaniin, pirezidaantii Yukreen Volodimir Zeelenskii waliin ta'uun, oomisha midhaanii geejjibsiisuuf karaa nageenya isaa eeggate haaraa diriirsuuf waliigaleera. Sochiin kun geejjiba daldalaa eeguu fi walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa hir'isuun akkasumas dhiyeessiin midhaanii fi anniisaa addunyaa irraatti miidhaa akka hin geenye taasisuuf kan karoorfameedha.

title: How vulnerable are cryptocurrency platforms?
english: The world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, Binance, recently suffered a massive security breach resulting in the theft of $6.3 billion in client assets. Experts believe hackers linked to the North Korean government are responsible for this record-breaking heist. This incident has sparked urgent calls for stricter industry regulations to protect investors and improve the safety of digital platforms.
amharic: የዓለማችን ትልቁ የክሪፕቶ ከረንሲ መገበያያ የሆነው ባይናንስ፣ በቅርቡ በደረሰበት ከፍተኛ የሳይበር ጥቃት 6.3 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ዋጋ ያላቸው የደንበኞች ንብረት ተዘርፏል። ጥቃቱን የሰሜን ኮሪያ መንግስት ድጋፍ ያላቸው ጠላፊዎች እንደፈጸሙት ባለሙያዎች ይገምታሉ። ይህ ታሪክ ትልቅ የሆነ ዝርፊያ የኢንቨስተሮችን እምነት ለመመለስ እና የዲጂታል መገበያያ መድረኮችን ደህንነት ለማረጋገጥ ጥብቅ ህግጋት እንዲወጡ አስገድዷል።
oromo: Buufata gurgurtaa maallaqa dijitaalaa addunyaa keessatti guddaa kan ta'e Binance irratti weerarri hakerootaa cimaan raawwatamee, qabeenyi abbootii qabeenyaa biliyoona 6.3 ta'u hatameera. Hayyoonni akka jedhanitti, hakerootni mootummaa Kooriyaa Kaabaatiin deeggaraman yakka kana raawwatan jedhamee shakkama. Gochi kun maallaqa dijitaalaa eeguufi amantii invastorootaa deebisanii ijaaruuf qajeelfamoonni cimaan akka barbaachisan gaaffii uumeera.

title: Palestinians ‘Stealing their own olives’
english: Palestinian farmers in Beita are currently forced to harvest their olives under dangerous conditions, starting before dawn and barricading roads to protect themselves from potential violence. They remain on high alert for attacks from Israeli settlers, which have surged to over 200 incidents since September. This situation highlights the extreme risks these farmers face just to access and collect their own seasonal crops.

title: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack
english: Binance has successfully replaced 90% of the $6.3 billion stolen during a massive recent cyberattack by utilizing its own corporate funds. The exchange has promised to fully protect its users from any financial loss and plans to restore withdrawal services soon. Authorities suspect that a North Korean hacker group may be behind this historic security breach, which is currently being investigated.
amharic: ቢናንስ በቅርቡ በደረሰው የ6.3 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሳይበር ጥቃት የጠፋውን ገንዘብ 90 በመቶ የሚሆነውን በራሱ የኩባንያው ገንዘብ መተካት ችሏል። ኩባንያው ተጠቃሚዎቹ የገንዘብ ኪሳራ እንዳይገጥማቸው ሙሉ ኃላፊነት እንደሚወስድና የገንዘብ ማውጣት አገልግሎቱን በቅርቡ እንደሚመልስ አስታውቋል። ባለስልጣናት ይህ ታሪካዊ የተባለለት የሳይበር ጥቃት በሰሜን ኮሪያ ጠላፊዎች የተፈጸመ ሊሆን እንደሚችል በመጠራጠር ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Binance weerara saaybarri guddaan irra gaheen maallaqa biiliyoona 6.3 hatame keessaa harka 90 olkaasaa ofii isaa irraa deebisee guuteera. Jijjiirraan kun kan raawwatame maamiltoonni isaa miidhaa maallaqaa akka hin qaqqabneef akka ta'eefi, tajaajilli maallaqa baasuu dhiyootti akka jalqabu ibsameera. title: From Mecca to the Moon: How Turkey is trying to become a player in space
english: Turkey is aggressively developing its space program with the goal of launching a lunar mission by 2027. The project relies heavily on domestically produced technology, aiming to reduce the country's dependence on foreign expertise and establish it as a significant global space power. By successfully orbiting and eventually landing on the moon, Turkey hopes to join an elite group of nations with advanced lunar capabilities.

title: The Sahel, a new front in the rivalry between Algeria and Morocco
english: The longstanding rivalry between Algeria and Morocco has expanded from the Maghreb into the Sahel region. Both nations are now actively competing for influence in countries like Mali, Niger, and Burkina Faso as these states move away from Western partnerships. While Algeria views its involvement as a security priority to manage border stability, both North African powers are maneuvering to secure their strategic, economic, and political interests in the area.

Biyoonni kun lamaan biyyoota akka Maalii, Niijeer fi Burkinaa Faasoo keessatti dhiibbaa uumuuf wal dorgomaa jiru; kunis ta'e kan ta'e biyyoonni Saahel kunneen michoota isaanii kan duraa kan ta'an biyyoota dhihaa irraa fagaachuu waan eegalaniifi. Aljeeriyaan garee kanatti hirmaachuun ishee nageenya biyyattii isa guddaa waan ta'eef, biyyoonni lamaanuu naannichatti faayidaa isaan qaban kanneen akka siyaasaa, diinagdee fi tarsiimoo jabeeffachuuf socho'aa jiru.

title: Why North Korea's 'elite' hackers are the prime suspect in major Binance hack
english: Major blockchain security firms have identified North Korea's state-sponsored Lazarus Group as the primary suspect behind a massive $6.3 billion theft from the Binance cryptocurrency exchange. Intelligence suggests the North Korean government uses these sophisticated cyberattacks to bypass international sanctions and generate essential revenue for the regime. These hackers, often trained from a young age, are part of a systematic state operation that has previously targeted various financial institutions to fund their activities.
amharic: የብሎክቼይን ደህንነት ተቋማት የሰሜን ኮሪያው የመንግስት የጠላፊዎች ቡድን (ላዛረስ ግሩፕ) ከባይናንስ የዲጂታል ገንዘብ ልውውጥ የተሰረቀውን 6.3 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ዋና ተጠርጣሪ መሆናቸውን አረጋግጠዋል። የሰሜን ኮሪያ መንግስት በሀገሪቱ ላይ የተጣለውን ማዕቀብ ለማለፍ እና ለስራው የሚያስፈልገውን ገቢ ለማግኘት እነዚህን ዘመናዊ የሳይበር ጥቃቶች እንደሚጠቀም ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ። እነዚህ የሰለጠኑ ጠላፊዎች፣ መንግስትን ለመደገፍ እና የገንዘብ ምንጭ ለማግኘት የተለያዩ የፋይናንስ ተቋማትን በየጊዜው ኢላማ ያደርጋሉ።
oromo: Dhaabbileen nageenyaa bulookcheenii akka jedhanitti, gareen hackarii mootummaa Kooriyaa Kaabaa kan 'Lazarus Group' jedhamu, shakkamaa guddaa boqonnaa jijjiirraa maallaqa dijitaalaa 'Binance' irraa qarshii biiliyoona 6.3 hatamee dha. Mootummaan Kooriyaa Kaabaa weerara saayibarii kanatti kan fayyadamu uggura idil-addunyaa darbee galii biyyaaf barbaachisu argachuuf akka ta'e ogeeyyiin ibsu. Hackaroonni kunis, mootummaa isaanii deeggaruuf jecha dhaabbilee faayinaansii adda addaa irratti xiyyeeffachuun hojii saayibarii seeraan alaa gaggeessu.

title: Spain train disaster clouds Sánchez chances of re-election
english: A major train crash in central Spain has resulted in 69 deaths, causing significant public outrage and undermining trust in Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez's government. With a snap general election approaching, the administration is facing intense pressure and calls for the Transport Minister's resignation due to infrastructure concerns. While the government blames human error for the tragedy, critics argue that systemic underinvestment and recurring technical failures are the root causes.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ስፔን የደረሰ አስከፊ የባቡር አደጋ 69 ሰዎችን በመቅጠፉ በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ፔድሮ ሳንቼዝ መንግስት ላይ ከፍተኛ ህዝባዊ ተቃውሞ አስነስቷል። አገሪቱ ወደ ምርጫ በምትሄድበት በዚህ ወቅት፣ ተቃዋሚዎች የመሠረተ ልማት ችግሮችን በመጥቀስ የትራንስፖርት ሚኒስትሩ ስልጣናቸውን እንዲለቁ እየጠየቁ ነው። መንግስት አደጋው የሰው ስህተት እንደሆነ ቢገልጽም፣ ተቺዎች ግን በዘርፉ ላይ በቂ ኢንቨስትመንት አለመደረጉ እና ተደጋጋሚ የቴክኒክ ብልሽቶች ለዚህ አደጋ ምክንያት ናቸው ብለዋል።
oromo: Giddu-galeessa Ispeenitti balaan baaburaa cimaan mudatee lubbuun namoota 69 darbuun isaa, amantii mootummaa Preezdaant Pedro Saancheez irraa qaban akka hir'atu godheera. Filannoon biyyaalessaa dhihaachaa waan jiruuf, mormitoonni rakkoo bu'uuraalee misoomaa akka sababaatti kaasuun ministirri geejjibaa aangoo akka gadhiisan gaafachaa jiru. Mootummaan balaan kun dogoggora nam-tolchee akka ta'e ibsus, gadoonni garuu invastimantii dhabuu fi rakkoolee teeknikaa deddeebi'anii mudatan akka sababaatti eeru.

title: Canada’s in-form Leylah Fernandez reaches Pan Pacific Open final in Tokyo
english: Canadian tennis star Leylah Fernandez has advanced to the final of the Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo after defeating Kamilla Rakhimova. Despite trailing early in both sets, Fernandez demonstrated great resilience to win the match in under two hours. This victory marks her third final appearance in the last month as she continues an impressive run of form on the Asian tour.

oromo: Leeylaa Fernaandez taphattuun tenisii Kaanaadaa, Kaamillaa Raakimoovaa mo'achuudhaan xumura dorgommii Paan Paasifik Oopeniin Tookiyootti gaggeeffamaa jiru irra geesseetti. title: LeBron James, Tyrese Maxey shine as 76ers beat Knicks in NBA Cup thriller
english: The Philadelphia 76ers defeated the New York Knicks 98-93 in their NBA Cup opening game. Tyrese Maxey led the scoring with 27 points, while LeBron James contributed 20 points and several crucial plays in the final moments to secure the win. This victory marks Philadelphia's second win against the Knicks this season.
amharic: የፊላዴልፊያ ሰቨንቲ ሲክሰርስ በኤንቢኤ ካፕ የመክፈቻ ጨዋታ የኒውዮርክ ኒክስን 98 ለ 93 አሸንፈዋል። ታይሪስ ማክሲ 27 ነጥቦችን በማስመዝገብ የቡድኑን ከፍተኛ ነጥብ ያስገኘ ሲሆን ሌብሮን ጄምስም 20 ነጥቦችን በመጨመር እና በጨዋታው የመጨረሻ ደቂቃዎች ወሳኝ እንቅስቃሴዎችን በማድረግ ድሉ እንዲረጋገጥ አድርጓል። ይህ ውጤት ፊላዴልፊያ በዚህ የውድድር ዘመን በኒክስ ላይ ያሳካው ሁለተኛው ድል ነው።
oromo: Fiilaadelfiyaa Seventii Siksars tapha baninsa NBA Cup irratti Niiw Yoork Niiks 98-93n injifateera. Taayiris Maaksii qabxii 27 galchuun dursaa yoo ta'u, Leebroon Jeems qabxii 20 galchuufi daqiiqawwan dhumaa irratti tarkaanfiiwwan murteessoo fudhachuun injifannoo kana mirkaneesseera. Injifannoon kun Fiilaadelfiyaan yeroo lammaffaaf Niiks injifannoo itti argatte dha.

title: The selective solidarity at the heart of India’s voter protests
english: Widespread protests are taking place across India to demand the reinstatement of 130 million voters who were removed from electoral rolls due to a controversial document-based verification process. While opposition groups and citizens are now uniting against this systemic exclusion, critics point out that this solidarity ignores the earlier warnings from Muslims regarding the discriminatory nature of citizenship laws. The movement currently faces internal tension as it seeks to address voter disenfranchisement without fully confronting the underlying legal frameworks that originally targeted minority communities.
amharic: በህንድ በመንግስት የሰነድ ማጣሪያ ሂደት ከምርጫ ዝርዝር ውስጥ የተሰረዙትን 130 ሚሊዮን መራጮች መልሶ ለማካተት ሀገር አቀፍ ተቃውሞዎች እየተካሄዱ ነው። የአሁኑ ተቃውሞ ህዝባዊ ድጋፍ እያገኘ ቢሆንም፣ የህንድ የፖለቲካ ተቃዋሚዎች እና ተሳታፊዎች በ2019 ሙስሊሞች ስላቀረቡት አድሎአዊ የዜግነት ህግ ማስጠንቀቂያ ግድ የለሽ መሆናቸው ትችት እየቀረበባቸው ነው። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ የምርጫ መብት መገፈፍን ብቻ ሳይሆን፣ በጥቂቶች ላይ ያነጣጠረውን አድሎአዊ የህግ ማዕቀፍም መታገል እንዳለበት እየተጠየቀ ይገኛል።
oromo: Indiyaa keessatti namoonni miliyoona 130 ta’an, akkaataa galmee filannoo irratti godhamee fi sanada mirkaneessu gaafatuun erga haquu booda, mormiin bal’aan biyyattii keessatti adeemsifamaa jira. Mormiin kun hirmaannaa uummataa kan argate ta’us, gareewwan mormituu fi hirmaattota biroo, rakkoo seera lammiummaa kan bara 2019 Muslimoonni irratti akeekkachiisanii turan irraatti xiyyeeffachuu dhiisuun isaanii qaeeqqamaa jira. Sochiin kun mirga sagalee kennuu kabachiisuu qofa osoo hin taane, bu’uura seeraa xiqqoota irratti xiyyeeffatu kana irratti mari’achuu akka qabu dhaamsa dabarsaa jira.

title: What has it cost to keep Al Jazeera on air for 30 years?
english: Al Jazeera is currently reflecting on its three-decade journey in global journalism. The media network is examining the significant challenges and professional sacrifices encountered while maintaining its broadcasting operations over the last 30 years. This retrospective highlights the network's long-term commitment to reporting despite the complex political and operational landscapes it has navigated.
amharic: አልጀዚራ በዓለም አቀፍ የጋዜጠኝነት ጉዞው የ30 ዓመት ዘመኑን እያከበረ ይገኛል። የዜና ተቋሙ ባለፉት ሦስት አሥርት ዓመታት ውስጥ ስርጭቱን ለማስቀጠል የገጠሙትን ዋና ዋና ተግዳሮቶች እና መስዋዕትነቶች በመለስ እያሰላሰለ ነው። ይህ የውይይት መድረክ፣ ተቋሙ ውስብስብ በሆኑ የፖለቲካ እና የሥራ አካባቢዎች ውስጥ ሆኖ ለዘገባው የገባውን ቃል ኪዳን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Al Jazeera waggoota 30 darban keessatti gama gabaasa oduu addunyaan imala isaa sadarkaa irra gahe xiinxalaa jira. Miidiyaan kun waggoota soddoma darbanif tamsaasa isaa itti fufsiisuuf qormaatawwan guguddaa fi wareegama kaffale irratti xiyyeeffata. Ibsi kun, rakkoolee siyaasaa fi haala hojii cimaa keessa darbee darbees, dhaabbatichi gabaasa dhugaa ummataaf dhiheessuuf murannoo qabaachuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: After the ‘martyr’s’ funeral: The families left behind by Yemen’s war
english: The ongoing conflict in Yemen has led to a significant rise in casualties, resulting in frequent funerals for both Houthi fighters and government soldiers. Beyond the public ceremonies, the families of these fallen combatants face profound emotional trauma and severe financial instability. Many survivors are struggling to cover basic living expenses after losing the primary breadwinners who supported their households.
amharic: በየመን እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት የሟቾች ቁጥር በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንዲጨምር በማድረግ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎችና የመንግስት ወታደሮች ቀብር ተደጋጋሚ እንዲሆን አድርጓል። ከቀብር ስነስርዓቱ በኋላ ለሟቾች ቤተሰቦች ትልቅ የስሜት ቀውስና የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ይከተላል። ብዙዎቹ የተረፉ ቤተሰቦች የቤተሰባቸውን የገቢ ምንጭ በመነጠቃቸው የዕለት ተዕለት ኑሯቸውን ለመምራት ከፍተኛ ችግር ላይ ወድቀዋል።
oromo: Waraanni Yemen keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru lakkoofsa namoota du'anii dabaluun, awwaalcha loltoota Houthii fi waraana mootummaa gara garaa dachaa taasiseera. Sirna awwaalchaa booda, maatiin loltoota wareegamanii miira gadadoo fi rakkoo dinagdee cimaa keessa seenu. Maatiin hedduun gargaarsa maallaqaa fi humna jireenyaa ta'anii kan turan namoota isaanii waan dhabaniif, jireenya guyyaa guyyaaf baasii barbaachisu guuttachuu dadhabaniiru.

title: Israeli strike on Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza kills Palestinian
english: Recent Israeli airstrikes in Gaza have resulted in the deaths of two Palestinian men. One individual was killed during an attack on the Nuseirat refugee camp located in the central part of the territory. Additionally, another man passed away from injuries he previously received during a separate strike in the Tal al-Hawa neighborhood of Gaza City.
amharic: በጋዛ በተፈጸሙ የእስራኤል የአየር ድብደባዎች ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። አንደኛው ግለሰብ በጋዛ መካከለኛው ክፍል በሚገኘው የኑሲራት የስደተኞች ካምፕ ላይ በተሰነዘረ ጥቃት ተገድሏል። ሌላኛው ሰው ደግሞ ከዚህ ቀደም በጋዛ ከተማ ታታል-ሃዋ ሰፈር ላይ ደርሶበት በነበረው የአየር ጥቃት በደረሰበት ጉዳት ምክንያት ህክምና ሲደረግለት ቆይቶ ህይወቱ አልፏል።
oromo: Hojiin waraanaa Israa'el gaazaa keessatti gaggeessite lubbuu namoota lamaa galaafateera. Namni tokko buufata baqattootaa Nuseerat kan giddu-galeessa Gaazaa jiru irratti erga haleelamee booda lubbuun isaa darbeera. Kana malees, namni biroon tokko miidhaa kanaan dura naannoo Gaazaa magaalaa Tal al-Hawa keessatti isa mudateen wal qabatee yaalamaa utuu jiruu du'eera.

title: Palestinian man injured in Israeli strike on Gaza succumbs, report says
english: A Palestinian man named Arafat al-Ar'eer has passed away after suffering injuries from an Israeli airstrike in the Tal al-Hawa neighborhood of Gaza City. Separately, reports indicate that at least 12 people, including a family, were wounded in a recent drone attack near Khan Younis. These events highlight the ongoing violence and casualties occurring within the Gaza Strip.
amharic: አራፋት አል-አርኤር የተባሉ ፍልስጤማዊ በጋዛ ከተማ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ደርሶባቸው የነበረውን ጉዳት መቋቋም ባለመቻላቸው ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በተለየ መልኩ፣ በካን ዩኒስ አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመ ሌላ የድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ 12 ሰዎች መቁሰላቸው ተዘግቧል። እነዚህ ክስተቶች በጋዛ ሰርጥ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የጥቃት ሁኔታ እና የሰዎችን ህይወት መጥፋት የሚያሳዩ ናቸው።
oromo: Namni Falasxiin Arafat al-Ar'eer jedhamu, haleellaa qilleensaatiin magaalaa Gaazaatti isarratti raawwatameen miidhamee ture erga erga fayyuu dadhabee booda lubbuun isaa darbeera. Kana birattis, naannoo Khan Yuunisitti haleellaa xiyyaara nama malee (drone) qabuun namoonni 12 ol ta'an miidhamuun gabaafameera. Taateewwan kun naannoo Gaazaatti waraanni fi miidhaan namarra gahaa jiru hammaachaa adeemuu isaanii mul'isu.

title: Saudi-led coalition forces intercept Houthi drone over Riyadh region
english: Military forces led by Saudi Arabia successfully neutralized three Houthi-launched drones targeting different areas of the kingdom. The aerial interceptions occurred over the Riyadh region, the Eastern Province, and the southern part of the country. A coalition spokesperson confirmed the destruction of the aircraft, which were aimed at Saudi territory.
amharic: ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የምትመራው የቅንጅት ኃይሎች በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ወደ ሳዑዲ የተላኩ ሶስት ድሮኖችን መትተው ጥለዋል። ድሮኖቹ በሪያድ፣ በምስራቃዊው ግዛት እና በደቡባዊ የሀገሪቱ ክፍሎች ላይ እንዳሉ ነው የተቆጣጠሩት። የቅንጅቱ ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለጹት አውሮፕላኖቹ በሙሉ በሰላም ተደምስሰዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni gamtaa biyyoota Sa'udii durfamu, xiyyara malee namoota oofan (droni) garee Huutii biyyattii irratti duulchise sadii rukutanii kuffisaniiru. Droniin kunniin naannoo Riyaad, naannoo bahaa fi kibba biyyattii irratti kan xiyeeffatan turan. Dubbi himaan gamtichaa akka ibsetti, xiyyaroonni kunniin hundi erga gara lafaatti kufanii booda hatattamaan barbadeeffamaniiru.

title: Israeli air strikes target southern Lebanese town of Kfar Tebnit
english: Israeli military forces have conducted air strikes on the town of Kfar Tebnit in southern Lebanon. Additionally, troops are actively shelling and destroying infrastructure in the Bint Jbeil and Tyre regions. Large areas of southern Lebanon remain under Israeli military occupation as the conflict continues.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው የከፋር ተብኒት ከተማ ላይ የአየር ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። በተጨማሪም በቢንት ጅቤይል እና በጢሮስ አካባቢዎች የእስራኤል ጦር በመድፍ በመደብደብ ህንጻዎችን እያፈረሰ ይገኛል። በግጭቱ ምክንያት የደቡብ ሊባኖስ ትላልቅ ክፍሎች በእስራኤል ቁጥጥር ስር እንደሆኑ ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el ganda Kaifar Tebnit kan kibba Libaanoositti argamu irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwataniiru. Kana malees, waraanni Israa'el naannolee Bint Jbeil fi Tyre keessatti madafaan rukutuufi ijaarsota diiguu itti fufeera. Walitti bu'iinsa kana hordofee, kutaaleen gurguddoon kibba Libaanoos harka Israa'el jala jiraachuu isaanii gabaasni ni mul'isa.

title: Palestinian journalist returns home after 15 months in Israeli detention
english: Palestinian reporter Farah Abu Ayyash has been released after spending 15 months in Israeli administrative detention. She was initially arrested in August 2025 at her home for her work as a correspondent in the West Bank. After facing multiple legal delays and allegations of mistreatment, a military court finally dismissed her charges and allowed her to return to her family.
amharic: የፍልስጤሟ ጋዜጠኛ ፋራህ አቡ አያሽ በእስራኤል እስር ቤት ለ15 ወራት ከቆየች በኋላ ወደ ቤተሰቧ ተመልሳለች። ጋዜጠኛዋ በምዕራብ ባንክ በምትሰራው ስራ ምክንያት በነሀሴ 2025 ከቤቷ ተይዛ ታስራ ነበር። የህግ ሂደቶች ሲጓተቱባት እና ስቃይ እንደደረሰባት ከተዘገበ በኋላ፣ የኦፈር ወታደራዊ ፍርድ ቤት ክሱን በመሻር እንድትለቀቅ ወስኗል።
oromo: Gaazexeessituun Filisxeem Faraha Abuu Aayyaash ji'a 15f hidhaatti erga turtee booda gara maatii ishee deebiteetti. Isheenis hojii gaazexeessummaa ishee kanneen naannoo Baankiin Dhihaa irratti taasiftuun walqabatee Hagayya 2025 mana ishee irraa qabamte. Adeemsa seeraa dheeraa fi himannaa dararaa booda, mana murtii waraanaatti himannaan irratti dhiyaate haqamee akka gadhiifamtu ta'eera.

title: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
english: The United States has authorized the sale of 500 Patriot interceptor missiles to Ukraine to bolster its air defenses against Russian attacks. This $2.1 billion deal is fully funded by international partners including Canada, Germany, and Norway, rather than the US government. While the missiles are essential for defense, President Zelensky has cautioned that the supply process could take several years to complete.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ዩክሬን ከሩሲያ የሚሰነዘሩ የአየር ላይ ጥቃቶችን ለመከላከል የሚያስችሏትን 500 የፓትሪዮት ሚሳይሎች እንድትገዛ ፈቃድ ሰጥቷል። የ2.1 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ግዢው በአሜሪካ ሳይሆን እንደ ካናዳ፣ ጀርመን እና ኖርዌይ ባሉ አጋር ሀገራት የገንዘብ ድጋፍ የሚሸፈን ነው። ምንም እንኳን ሚሳይሎቹ ለዩክሬን መከላከያ ወሳኝ ቢሆኑም፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ መሳሪያዎቹ ሙሉ በሙሉ ለመድረስ ጥቂት ዓመታት ሊፈጅ እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa Yukreen haleellaa xiyyaaraa Ruusiyaan ishee irratti raawwattu of irraa ittisuuf akka gargaartu misayila Paatriyootii 500 akka bittu hayyameera. Waliigalteen doolaara biiliyoona 2.1 kun kan kafalamu mootummaa Ameerikaan utuu hin taane, biyyoota akka Kaanaadaa, Jarmanii fi Noorweeyiin yoo ta'u, kunis gargaarsa maallaqaa isaanii ti. Misayiloonni kun ittisa biyyattiiuf baay'ee barbaachisoo ta'us, pirezidaanti Zeelenskiin qaqqabbiin isaanii waggoota muraasa fudhachuu akka danda'u ibsaniiru.

title: Germany and France brace for protests on Halloween weekend
english: Germany and France are preparing for significant youth-led protests this Halloween weekend, driven by frustrations over the high cost of living, failing education systems, and limited future opportunities. Authorities in both countries are deploying thousands of extra police officers, while many businesses have boarded up their storefronts to prevent potential looting. These demonstrations follow a series of recent unrests where young protesters demanded government action regarding their economic and social grievances.
amharic: ጀርመን እና ፈረንሳይ በኑሮ ውድነት፣ በደካማ የትምህርት ጥራት እና በተስፋ ቢስነት የተነሳ በወጣቶች የሚመሩ ሰልፎች በዚህ የሃሎዊን ቅዳሜና እሁድ ይጠበቃሉ። ሁለቱም አገራት ተጨማሪ ፖሊሶችን በማሰማራት ላይ ሲሆኑ፣ ንብረት እንዳይወድም ብዙ የንግድ ተቋማት መስኮቶቻቸውን በጣውላ እየሸፈኑ ነው። እነዚህ ተቃውሞዎች ወጣቶች በመንግስት ላይ ያላቸውን ቅሬታ እና የመልካም አስተዳደር እጦት ለመግለጽ የሚያደርጉት ተከታታይ ትግል አካል ናቸው።
oromo: Jarmanii fi Faransaayiin dhuma torban kana ayyaana Haalowwiin waliin wal qabatee hiriira dargaggootaan durfamuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Hiriirtonni kun gatii jireenyaa ol ka'uu, hanqina barnootaa fi abdii dhabuu dhaloota haaraa mormaa jiru. Mootummoonni biyyoota lamaanii nageenya eeguuf poolisoota hedduu ramadanuun cinaatti, abbootiin qabeenyaas hiriirri gara jeequmsaatti akka hin jijjiiramneef iddoo hojii isaanii cufachaa jiru.

title: Brazil summons Argentinian diplomat over Bolsonaro’s flight to US
english: Brazil has summoned an Argentine diplomat to address concerns regarding the departure of Flavio Bolsonaro, who fled to the United States via Argentina following his defeat in the recent presidential election. Bolsonaro is currently under investigation for a money-laundering scandal and had been legally ordered to surrender his passport and remain in Brazil. This incident has caused increased diplomatic friction between the administrations of Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Argentine President Javier Milei.
amharic: ብራዚል የቅርብ ጊዜውን ፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ ከተሸነፈ በኋላ ወደ አርጀንቲና ከዚያም ወደ አሜሪካ የሸሸውን ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮን ጉዳይ አስመልክቶ የአርጀንቲና ዲፕሎማትን ጠርታለች። ቦልሶናሮ በገንዘብ ማጭበርበር ወንጀል ምርመራ ላይ የሚገኙ ሲሆን ፓስፖርታቸውን እንዲያስረክቡና ከሀገር እንዳይወጡ ትእዛዝ ተላልፎባቸው ነበር። ይህ ድርጊት በብራዚል ፕሬዚዳንት ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ እና በአርጀንቲናው ፕሬዚዳንት ጃቪየር ሚሌይ መካከል ያለውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ውጥረት ውስጥ የከተተው ይመስላል።
oromo: Brazil, Flavio Bolsonaro filannoo pirezidaantummaa dhiheenya adeemsifame erga injifatamee booda gara Arjentiinaa fi achii gara Ameerikaatti baqachuu isaatiin walqabatee dipilomaata Arjentiinaa waamtee gaaffii kaasteetti. Bolsonaro shakkii seeraan alaa maallaqa adii qulqulleessuu irratti kan qoratamaa jiru yoo ta'u, paspoortii isaa akka deebisuufi biyya keessaa akka hin baane ajajamee ture. Gochi kun walitti dhufeenya dipilomaasii pirezidaantii Brazil Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva fi pirezidaantii Arjentiinaa Javier Milei gidduu jiru hammaachisee jira.

title: Iran war live: Oil tankers hit in Hormuz; Trump says conflict will end soon
english: Four oil tankers were damaged by explosions and fires while navigating through the Strait of Hormuz. Iran’s Revolutionary Guard stated these vessels were using unofficial paths during the incidents. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump expressed confidence that the conflict will be resolved quickly, provided that Iran commits to abandoning its nuclear weapons program.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል ሲጓዙ የነበሩ አራት የነዳጅ መርከቦች በእሳት እና በፍንዳታ ተጎድተዋል። የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ መርከቦቹ ያልተፈቀዱ መንገዶችን እየተጠቀሙ እንደነበር ገልጿል። በሌላ በኩል ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኢራን የኒውክሌር ጦር መሳሪያ እንደማትፈልግ ማረጋገጫ እስሰጠች ድረስ ግጭቱ በቅርቡ እንደሚፈታ ያላቸውን እምነት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Dooniileen boba'aa afur daandii galaana Hormuz keessa utuu deemanii ibiddaan miidhaniiru. Eegdonni bulchiinsa gara jijjiirraa (IRGC) kan Iraan, dooniileen kun karaa seeraan alaa deemaa turan jedhaniiru. Gama biraatiin, Prezidaant Doonaald Traamp, Iraan meeshaa niwuukilaraa akka hin qabaanne mirkaneessite, waraanni kun yeroo dhiyootti kan xumuramuu akka ta'e dubbataniiru.

title: Fans voice support on final night of Macklemore’s ‘Free Palestine’ tour
english: Macklemore recently concluded his concert tour dedicated to advocating for Palestine. The artist organized these shows after being removed from Ed Sheeran's tour for publicly expressing his support for the Palestinian cause. Attendees gathered at the final performance to voice their solidarity with the artist's stance and the ongoing movement.
amharic: ማክልሞር ለፍልስጤም ነፃነት ሲሟገትበት የነበረውን የሙዚቃ ጉብኝቱን በስኬት አጠናቋል። ድምፃዊው ለፍልስጤም ያለውን ድጋፍ በግልጽ በመግለጹ ከኤድ ሺራን የሙዚቃ ጉብኝት ከተባረረ በኋላ ነው ይህንን የራሱን የሙዚቃ ዝግጅት ያዘጋጀው። አድናቂዎቹ በመጨረሻው የኮንሰርት ምሽት ላይ ተገኝተው ለአርቲስቱ አቋም ያላቸውን አጋርነት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Maakleemoor daawwannaa muuziqaa 'Falastiin bilisa haa taatu' jedhuun geggeessaa ture xumureera. Artistichi sagantaa kana kan qopheesse, Falastiiniif deggarsa qabu ibsachuu isaatiin tourii Ed Sheeran irraa erga ari'amee booda. Hordoftoonni isaa halkan xumuraa kanatti argamuun, yaada isaatiif deggarsa qaban ibsataniiru.

title: Polish police deployed to top court after head judge suspended
english: Polish police were sent to the Constitutional Tribunal in Warsaw after the head judge, Bogdan Swieczkowski, was suspended from his duties. The government claims Swieczkowski blocked legally elected judges from working, fueling a long-standing conflict over political control of the judiciary. This decision sparked protests by his supporters, leading to police intervention and some arrests as authorities attempt to restore the rule of law.
amharic: የፖላንድ የሕገ-መንግስት ፍርድ ቤት ፕሬዝዳንት ቦግዳን ስዊችኮቭስኪ ከሥራ መታገዳቸውን ተከትሎ በአካባቢው ውጥረት በመፈጠሩ ፖሊስ ወደ ፍርድ ቤቱ ተሰማርቷል። መንግሥት ዳኛው የተመረጡ ዳኞች ሥራቸውን እንዳይጀምሩ በመከልከላቸው ለሥልጣን አለአግባብ መጠቀም ተጠያቂ መሆናቸውን ገልጿል። ይህ ውሳኔ በዳኛው ደጋፊዎች ዘንድ ተቃውሞን የቀሰቀሰ ሲሆን፣ በቦታው በተፈጠረ ግጭትም ፖሊስ አንዳንድ ግለሰቦችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Mana Murtii Heeraa Poolaand Bogdaan Swieczkowski hojiirraa akka dhaabbatan murtaa'uu hordofee, gamoo mana murtichaa biratti poolisiin ergamuun isaa ibsameera. Mootummaan akka jedhetti, pirezidaantichi abbootii seeraa seeraan filataman hojiitti akka hin seenne gufuu waan ta'aniif tarkaanfiin kun fudhatameera. Murtee kana mormuudhaan deggertoonni isaanii hiriira bahanii waan turaniif, walitti buiinsi uumamee poolisiin namoota muraasa to'annoo jala oolcheera.

title: Houthi drone intercepted over Saudi Arabia's southern region, coalition says
english: The Saudi-led coalition successfully intercepted and neutralized a drone sent by Houthi forces toward southern Saudi Arabia. According to coalition officials, the aircraft was destroyed before it could cause any damage. This incident is part of the ongoing regional conflict involving the Houthi movement.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ የሚመራው ጥምረት በሁቲ አማፂያን ወደ ደቡባዊ ሳውዲ አረቢያ የተላከ ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላን (ድሮን) መትቶ መጣሉን አስታውቋል። የጥምረቱ ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለጹት አውሮፕላኑ ምንም ጉዳት ሳያደርስ በአየር ላይ ወድሟል። ይህ ድርጊት በሁቲዎች እና በሳውዲ ጥምረት መካከል እየተካሄደ ካለው ግጭት አንዱ አካል ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Saudii durfamu, xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) garee Huthitiin gara kibba Saudi Arabiaatti ergame qabee barbadeesseera. Akka dubbi himaan waraana kanaa jedhanitti, xiyyaarichi utuu miidhaa hin geessisiin bakka inni jirutti fashalaameera. Taateen kun waraana gama kanaan deemaa jiru keessaa isa tokko dha.

title: Trump says 'there are talks', Tehran wants to talk
english: Former President Donald Trump stated that negotiations with Iran are underway and claimed that Tehran is interested in reaching a deal. He described the ongoing situation as an unconventional type of conflict, emphasizing that the U.S. is not rushing into a traditional war. Trump continues to send mixed signals, alternating between the possibility of military action and the prospect of a diplomatic resolution.
amharic: ቀድሞውኑ የነበሩት የአሜሪካ ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከአይራን ጋር ንግግሮች እየተደረጉ እንደሆነና ኢራንም ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ፍላጎት እንዳላት ተናግረዋል። አሁን ያለው ሁኔታ ከተለመደው ጦርነት የተለየ መሆኑን የገለጹት ትራምፕ፣ አሜሪካ ወደ ተለመደው ጦርነት ለመግባት እንደማትቸኩል አስታውቀዋል። ፕሬዚዳንቱ በወታደራዊ እርምጃ እና በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ መካከል የሚወዛገብ አቋም እያሳዩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaantii duraanii Donald Traamp mariin biyyattii fi Iraan gidduutti jalqabamee jiraachuu fi Iraanis walii galtee irra gahuuf fedhii akka qabdu ibsaniiru. Haalli amma jiru waraana idilee kan hin taane ta'uu fi Ameerikaan waraana akkasii keessatti ariifachuu akka hin barbaanne dubbataniiru. Traamp kallattii waraanaatti seenuu fi karaa marii furuun danda'amuu gidduutti yaada wal faallessu kennuusaanii itti fufaniiru.

title: 'Trump's buddies in big oil' profited $130bn from Iran war, US senator says
english: Senator Chris Van Hollen claims that major oil companies aligned with Donald Trump have gained $130 billion in profits due to the ongoing conflict with Iran. He argues that this financial gain has come at the expense of ordinary American families, who are struggling with significantly higher fuel prices. The Senator is calling for an immediate end to the hostilities to protect lives and ease the economic burden on citizens.
amharic: ሴናተር ክሪስ ቫን ሆለን እንደገለጹት፣ ከዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጋር ወገንተኝነት ያላቸው ታላላቅ የነዳጅ ኩባንያዎች ከአሜሪካ እና ከኢራን ግጭት የተነሳ 130 ቢሊዮን ዶላር አትርፈዋል። ይህ ከፍተኛ ትርፍ የተገኘው ተራ የአሜሪካ ቤተሰቦች በነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪ ምክንያት የገንዘብ ጫና ውስጥ በገቡበት ወቅት ነው። ሴናተሩ የሰው ህይወትን ለመታደግ እና የነዳጅ ዋጋን ለመቀነስ ግጭቱ በአስቸኳይ እንዲቆም ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Senator Kris Vaan Hollen akka jedhutti, dhaabbileen boba'aa gurguddoo kan Donald Traamp waliin hidhata qaban walitti bu'iinsa Iraan waliin jiruun bu'aa dolaara biliyoona 130 argataniiru. Bu'aan kun kan argame maatiin Ameerikaa gatii boba'aa dabale kaffaluun miidhamuun isaanii wajjiini. Senatorichi lubbuu namaa baraaruufi baasii lammiilee hir'isuuf jecha waraanni kun hatattamaan dhaabbachuu qaba jedhaniiru.

title: More than 530 Palestinian families forced from Hebron during Israeli siege
english: Israeli forces have displaced over 530 Palestinian families in Hebron following a strict citywide lockdown. The military action was initiated after two brothers attacked soldiers at a checkpoint, leading to their deaths and the subsequent demolition of their family homes. Many residents remain unable to retrieve vital supplies and medication due to ongoing troop presence and restrictions.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በሄብሮን ከተማ ባደረጉት ጥብቅ ክልከላ ከ530 በላይ የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦች ከቤታቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ ተገደዋል። ይህ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ሁለት ወንድማማቾች በወታደራዊ ኬላ ላይ ጥቃት በማድረሳቸው ምክንያት ነው። በአካባቢው በሚገኘው የጦር ሰራዊት ገደብ ምክንያት ብዙ ነዋሪዎች የህክምና ቁሳቁሶችን እና የግል ንብረቶቻቸውን ማግኘት አልቻሉም።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el magaalaa Hebron keessatti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhateen maatiin Palesxinaa 530 ol ta'an mana isaanii gadhiisanii akka ba'an dirqisiifamaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame obboloonni lama buufata waraanaa irratti haleellaa erga raawwatanii booda yoo ta'u, mana isaaniis waraanni diigeera. Sababa dhorkaa jiruun jiraattonni hedduun qorichaa fi meeshaalee barbaachisoo ta'an fudhachuu akka hin dandeenye gabaasameera.

title: Israeli drone strike in Gaza's Khan Younis injures at least 14
english: An Israeli drone attack on a public mobile device charging station in Khan Younis, Gaza, resulted in at least 14 injuries on Friday. The victims, who included a family with their children, were hit in the al-Maslakh neighborhood. Civil defense officials confirmed the incident as the strike caused significant harm to those gathered at the site.
amharic: አርብ ዕለት በጋዛ ካን ዩኒስ ከተማ በአል-ማስላክ አካባቢ በሚገኝ የሞባይል ቻርጅ ማድረጊያ ጣቢያ ላይ በእስራኤል ድሮን በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 14 ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል እናት፣ አባት እና ልጆቻቸው ይገኙበታል። የጋዛ ሲቪል መከላከያ ኤጀንሲ ጥቃቱ በቦታው የነበሩ በርካታ ንፁሃን ላይ ጉዳት እንዳደረሰ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Guyyaa Jimaata darbe magaalaa Gaaza, Kaani Yuuniis keessatti xiyyaaraan lafarraa malee kan to'atamu (drone) bakka bilbila itti chaarjii godhatanii jirutti haleellaa raawwateen namoonni 14 ol ta'an miidhamaniiru. Miidhamtoota kana keessatti abbaa, haadhaafi ijoolleen isaanii kan argaman yoo ta'u, haleellaan kun naannoo Al-Maslaak jedhamutti kan raawwatame dha. Qaamoleen nageenyaa gaazaas namoonni bakka kana turan miidhaa cimaaf saaxilamuu isaanii mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Police deployed during stand-off over control of Poland's top court
english: Tensions in Poland have escalated as the government attempts to remove the top two justices of the Constitutional Tribunal, accusing them of misconduct. Riot police were stationed outside the court building in Warsaw to block protesters from the opposition party who are opposing these dismissals. Prime Minister Donald Tusk defended the move as a necessary step to restore the rule of law after years of political instability involving the court.
amharic: የፖላንድ መንግሥት የሀገሪቱን ከፍተኛ ሕገ-መንግሥታዊ ፍርድ ቤት ከፍተኛ ዳኞች ከሥልጣን ለማንሳት በመወሰኑ በሀገሪቱ ውጥረት ነግሷል። መንግሥት ዳኞቹን በወንጀል በመክሰስ ያለባቸውን የሕግ ከለላ ለማንሳት ጥረት ሲያደርግ፣ ተቃዋሚዎች ይህን ድርጊት በመቃወም በፍርድ ቤቱ አቅራቢያ ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ዶናልድ ቱስክ ይህ እርምጃ የሕግ የበላይነትን ለማስከበር የተወሰደ አስፈላጊ እርምጃ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Poolaand abbootii seeraa mana murtii olaanaa lama hojii irraa ari'uuf yaalii gochuun isaa biyyattii keessatti mormii fi walitti bu'iinsa uumee jira. Poolisiin humnaan eeguun mormitoota mormii dhageessisaa turan mana murtiichaa irraa fageessuuf dirqamee jira. Muummeen Ministiraa Donald Tusk tarkaanfiin kun seera kabajchiisuuf kan fudhatame ta'uu ibsuun, gama biraatiin gareen mormituu PiS tarkaanfichaan mormanii jiru.

title: Swiss supreme court upholds Liberian ex-rebel commander’s 20-year sentence
english: Switzerland's supreme court has confirmed a 20-year prison sentence for former Liberian rebel leader Alieu Kosiah for war crimes committed during the early 1990s. While his conviction for war crimes remains, the court overturned his previous conviction for crimes against humanity, citing that the law was not applicable retroactively. This ruling marks the first time a Swiss civilian court has finalized a conviction for war crimes, holding a Liberian official accountable for atrocities from the civil war era.
amharic: የስዊዘርላንድ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞው የላይቤሪያ አማፂ መሪ አሊዩ ኮሲያ በ1990ዎቹ መጀመሪያ ላይ በፈጸሙት የጦር ወንጀል የተፈረደባቸውን የ20 ዓመት እስራት አጸደቀ። ፍርድ ቤቱ ለጦር ወንጀል የሰጠውን ውሳኔ ቢያጸድቅም፣ ቀደም ሲል የተላለፈውን በሰብአዊነት ላይ የተፈጸመ ወንጀል ውሳኔ ግን ህጉ ወደ ኋላ ተመልሶ አይሰራም በሚል መርህ ውድቅ አድርጎታል። ይህ ውሳኔ የስዊዘርላንድ ሲቪል ፍርድ ቤት የጦር ወንጀል ሲያረጋግጥ የመጀመሪያው ሲሆን፣ የላይቤሪያ ባለስልጣን በሲቪል ጦርነቱ ወቅት ለፈጸሙት ድርጊት ተጠያቂ መሆናቸውን ያሳያል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Siwiizerlaand, ajajaa waraana Libeeriyaa durii Aliyuu Koosiyaah irratti hidhaa waggaa 20 darbe raggaasiseera. Koosiyaah bara 1990 keessa waraana sivilii yeroo turetti yakka waraana raawwachuun isaa kan mirkanaa'e yoo ta'u, manni murtichaa yakka namummaa irratti raawwatame jedhamee dur ba'e ture garuu seeraan kan hin hojjenne ta'uu ibsuun haqee jira. Murtii kanaan, mana murtii Siwiizerlaanditti yakka waraanaaf murtiin itti kenname kan jalqabaa ta'uun, itti gaafatamummaan ajajaa Libeeriyaa kun akka mirkanaa'u taasiseera.

title: US appeals court again rejects Trump bid to set aside California ballots
english: A U.S. appeals court has dismissed a legal attempt by the Trump administration to invalidate 20,000 ballots in California, citing constitutional concerns. The court ruled that removing these votes would unfairly strip eligible citizens of their right to participate in the upcoming midterm elections. Officials have questioned the accuracy of the government's claims, noting that similar lists provided to other states contained significant errors.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የይግባኝ ሰሚ ፍርድ ቤት የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በካሊፎርኒያ ግዛት ውስጥ የ20,000 መራጮችን ድምፅ ለመሰረዝ ያቀረበውን ጥያቄ በድጋሚ ውድቅ አድርጓል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ይህ ድርጊት የሕገ መንግሥት ጥሰት ከመሆኑም በላይ ብቁ የሆኑ መራጮች መብታቸውን እንዳያጡ ያደርጋል ሲል ወስኗል። አስተዳደሩ ያቀረበው የመራጮች ዝርዝር ትክክለኛነት አጠያያቂ መሆኑንና ተመሳሳይ ችግሮች በሌሎች ግዛቶችም መታየታቸውን መረጃዎች ያመለክታሉ።
oromo: Mana murtii ol'aanaa Ameerikaa tokko, bulchiinsi Trump sagalee namoota 20,000 Kaalifoorniyaa keessatti kenname akka haqamuuf dhiheeffate lammata irra deebi'uun diduudhaan gatuu isaa ibseera. Murtii kanaan, sagalee kana haqamuun mirga lammiilee sagaluuf heeyyamame irratti cabsuu waan ta'eef, heera biyyattii wajjin kan wal-faallessu ta'uu ibse. Dhimmi kun, ragaan bulchiinsi Trump dhiheeffate inni namoota lammii hin taane jedhu dhugaa irratti kan hin hundoofneefi dogoggora qabaachuu isaati.

title: G20 drops group photo as Europeans refuse to stand with Lavrov
english: The G20 meeting in Atlanta canceled its traditional group photo because European officials declined to be photographed with Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov. This decision highlights the ongoing diplomatic tensions caused by Russia's invasion of Ukraine. With the group deeply divided, officials do not expect to produce a joint statement, opting instead for a summary provided by the meeting's chair.
amharic: የጂ-20 የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች ስብሰባ የአውሮፓ ተወካዮች ከሩሲያው የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሰርጌ ላቭሮቭ ጋር ለመነሳት ፈቃደኛ ባለመሆናቸው ባህላዊውን የቡድን ፎቶግራፍ ሰርዟል። ይህ ውሳኔ በዩክሬን ወረራ ምክንያት በቡድኑ አባላት መካከል የተፈጠረውን ከፍተኛ የዲፕሎማሲ ክፍፍል ያሳያል። አባላቱ በጋራ መግለጫ ላይ መስማማት ባለመቻላቸው ስብሰባው ያለ የጋራ መግለጫ እንደሚጠናቀቅ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Garee G20 waamicha Atlanta irratti, bakka bu'oonni Awurooppaa ministira dhimmi alaa Raashiyaa Sergey Lavrov waliin suuraa ka'uuf waan didaniif suuraa garee duudhaa ta'e sana haqeera. title: Crypto giant Binance attempting to recover $6.3bn stolen in hack linked to North Korea
english: Binance is actively working to recover $6.3 billion in digital assets stolen during a massive, sophisticated cyberattack linked to North Korean hackers. The exchange has successfully frozen and secured $3 billion of the stolen funds and assured customers that their accounts are protected. U.S. authorities, including the Secret Service and FBI, are collaborating with the company to track down the criminals and retrieve the remaining stolen money.
amharic: ቢናንስ በሰሜን ኮሪያ ጠላፊዎች ተፈጸመ በተባለ ታላቅ የሳይበር ጥቃት የተሰረቀውን 6.3 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ለማስመለስ ጥረት እያደረገ ነው። የዲጂታል ንብረት መገበያያ ጣቢያው እስካሁን ከስርቆቱ 3 ቢሊዮን ዶላሩን ማቀብ እንደቻለ እና የደንበኞቹን ገንዘብ እንደሚሸፍን አስታውቋል። የአሜሪካ የፌዴራል መርማሪ ቢሮ (FBI) እና ሚስጥራዊ አገልግሎት አባላትም ወንጀለኞቹን ለመያዝ እና የተሰረቀውን ቀሪ ገንዘብ ለማግኘት ከኩባንያው ጋር እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Binance qabeenya dijitaala qimmiin biyya Korea kaabaa tiin hatame hamma doolaara biliyoona 6.3 deeffachuuf tattaaffii gochaa jira.
